contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]VS PF AVG ; R/ [SALVS REI] PVBLICAE

: Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Theodosius (379-395), Victory with captive left, Reece period 21, issue of 388-402. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, hair stiffly vertical. Obverse inscription: [--]VS PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left dragging small captive. Barred Rho in left field. Reverse inscription: [SALVS REI] PVBLICAE.
